Sky.text: Explain why the sky is blue in two sentences.

Python.text: Write a Python function that merges overlapping integer intervals. Include type hints and three assert-based examples. Output only Python code.

JSON.text: Return only a JSON object describing three books. Use the keys "books", "title", "author", "year", and "tags". Each book must have exactly two tags.
